gen-gf-geostar-fill-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Wide and showy up top: Geostar Fill spaces its letters generously, with bowls that swell only slightly at their fullest. Stint Ultra Expanded is a serif that holds each character apart, curves never thinning at the turns.
gen-gf-gideon-roman-gf-kiwi-maru: Bold lettering leads, with a c opened like a pair of calipers in Gideon Roman. Kiwi Maru follows in a serif with rings of o that keep one steady wall, and terminals that stop well short of the stem.
gen-gf-gideon-roman-gf-padyakke-expanded: Gideon Roman opens the pair with a c spread like calipers and a low shift between thick and thin. And Padyakke Expanded One, a text serif, keeps its round bowls uniform, so a long passage moves along like beads on a slack rope.
gen-gf-gideon-roman-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Distinctive from the first glance, Gideon Roman hangs its c open like a pair of calipers over the page. But Stint Ultra Expanded, a classic serif, lets each character float apart, with no brush-style swell anywhere to echo it.
gen-gf-give-you-glory-fs-bespoke-serif: Give You Glory writes with a friendly, hand-drawn looseness, leaving gaps in its rounded glyphs. Bespoke Serif, a classic serif with thin strokes at half the weight of thick ones, wants generous size since it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-goblin-one-gf-graduate: Fat stems, hairline thread: Goblin One looks like cut ribbon laid beside wire, with every glyph set well apart. Graduate, a text serif, answers with pinch-free curves and wide letterspace, so the page has one loud voice and one dignified one.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-gambetta: Round forms that read like open parentheses mark Goldman, wide and commanding with a big lowercase. And Gambetta, a classic serif, brings stroke weight that shifts noticeably but never dramatically, tapering gently like a candle flame.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-abyssinica-sil: Commanding in its wide stance, Goldman keeps its strokes at a low shift in weight. Abyssinica SIL, a text serif, adds a quiet watercolor-like contrast and a tall middle zone, giving the page a literary counterweight.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-cambo: Bold and commanding, Goldman spreads its letters wide. Cambo, a serif with a short step from lowercase top to capital top, adds a modest thick and thin rhythm that gives the heading something refined to lean on.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-fanwood-text: Round forms like open parentheses give Goldman its look, set wide with a big lowercase beside small capitals. Fanwood Text, a text serif, adds a large-eyed lowercase and gentle swelling, while Goldman earns its keep big and brief.
